Container.Name: deadwax
Container.Overview: search bar for musicbrainz that downloads through slskd

Config.Name: slskd API key
Config.Description: API key for your slskd instance

Config.Name: MusicBrainz contact email
Config.Description: Your email address. MusicBrainz asks every app for a contact; deadwax writes the rest of its user agent itself, version included.

Config.Name: cover art size
Config.Description: 250 | 500 | 1200 | full. How big a cover to save from the Cover Art Archive - full is the original upload, often several MB. Also changeable in the settings tab.

Config.Name: fetch lyrics
Config.Description: on | off. Look up lyrics on LRCLIB for each album as it is filed, saved as a .lrc beside every track. Also changeable in the settings tab.

Config.Name: lyrics lead (ms)
Config.Description: Milliseconds to move synced lyrics earlier as they are written (negative: later). LRCLIB timings trail the singing a little - if lines land a beat late, try 300. Also changeable in the settings tab.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run as. On unraid this is usually 99 (nobody). Match slskd so file ownership stays consistent.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run as. On unraid this is usually 100 (users). Match slskd so file ownership stays consistent.

Config.Name: organize mode
Config.Description: off | dry_run | copy | move. Leave on dry_run until the event log shows it finding your files, then switch to copy or move.

Config.Name: slskd downloads
Config.Description: Must be the SAME directory slskd writes finished downloads to, or organizing will find nothing.

Config.Name: config
Config.Description: Holds the database remembering which download belongs to which release
